verdict.rationale: Context.dev has a dedicated rate-limits documentation page saying authenticated API responses expose headers when a per-minute limit applies, so a data engineer can see the enforced limit at runtime. The evidence does not show the actual numeric thresholds per key or plan, so the limit can't be known in advance from the docs as cited. Missing for 10: published numeric requests-per-minute/second values per key or plan, details of the throttling behavior (e.g., 429 handling or retry-after), independent or hands-on corroboration.
